about.title: Judgment before catalog.
about.lead: StackAI Learn exists to explain AI tools the way they are actually used: with limits and with a method.
about.p1: The directory is small on purpose. We would rather publish an honest profile — what it does well, where it fails, how to start — than a list of 200 logos. Tutorials teach a repeatable flow, not a tour of the UI.
about.p2: We do not chase an infinite catalog. Every profile has to survive one question: what job is this for, and what is the first useful flow?
about.p3: stackailearn.com ships as a static site on Cloudflare Pages: fast to serve, easy to cache, simple to grow.
about.v1Body: If we cannot explain a useful first flow in five steps, the tool does not ship yet.
about.v2Body: Every profile has cons. The AI that 'does everything' does not exist. Judgment does.
about.v3Body: Fewer adjectives, more method. If the text cannot be used tomorrow, it does not ship.

legal.privacyP1: StackAI Learn (stackailearn.com) is a directory and a set of tutorials. The site operator is the data controller. Contact: {email}.

legal.privacyP3: If we turn on analytics (Cloudflare Web Analytics or similar) or ads (AdSense or another network), those vendors process data under their own policies. Until a token or ca-pub is set in config, those scripts do not load.
legal.privacyP4: Affiliate links may tell the vendor you arrived from this site. Editorial copy does not change because of a commission. Details: /disclosure.
legal.privacyP5: You can ask for access, correction or deletion of data we hold about you (for example a newsletter signup) by writing to {email}.
legal.termsP1: StackAI Learn content is informational. Third-party tools change price, UI and terms. Always check the official site before you pay.
legal.termsP2: We do not guarantee a tutorial matches today's UI to the pixel. If a step is gone, write to {email}.
legal.termsP3: Do not scrape the site to rebuild the directory as a competing product, or present the copy as yours without attribution.
legal.termsP4: Some links are affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission. You do not pay more. Full notice: /disclosure.

pack.title: Stack AI in 14 days
pack.promise: Not another endless AI course. The method + templates to publish tutorials and comparisons with Cursor and Grok Bot in 14 days.
pack.checkoutPreview: Checkout is not connected yet. The button opens the files so you can see what is included.
pack.forBody: For someone who wants to publish tool profiles, tutorials and comparisons with Cursor and a Grok Bot that only drafts. If you already have a site — or you are about to ship one — this is the method and the templates.
pack.notForBody: Not for anyone looking for a 40-hour video course, or a shortcut to «live off AI». It also does not replace learning Cursor.
pack.daysSubtitle: Fourteen days. One block a day. No endless module.
pack.filesSubtitle: The 14 days on this site, with steps. Templates open on the day you need them.
pack.howBody: You buy. You land on the 14 days on this site. One block a day: what to do, when it is done, and that day's template. No video, no login.
pack.faq1a: No. Fourteen blocks on this site, with steps and templates. You read, you do, you publish.
pack.faq2q: Do I need to know how to code?
pack.faq2a: No. You need to use Cursor. The pack assumes you open it and give it instructions.
pack.faq3a: No. It promises a working method for publishing with judgment. The rest is on you.
pack.ctaText: This tutorial is one piece. The pack has the templates and the 14-day plan to publish the rest.
pack.ctaTextCompact: The pack has the templates and the 14-day plan to publish the rest. Not another course.
pack.thanksLead: One block a day. Start at day 1. You do not need to read it all today.
pack.thanksHow: Each day has the goal, the steps and when it is done. The template (if that day has one) sits at the end.
pack.thanksPreview: This is the access page. When checkout is live, you will land here after payment.
